statement: A byte string containing a map that holds the same key twice is not decoded
deviation: {"bar":3,"foo":1,"foo":2}. The duplication of the key "foo" is the sole deviation. There is no verbatim occurrence of "duplicate" in the spec text (measured by grep, req/33 §4); the basis is an indirect implication from L58's sort clause -- two identical keys cannot satisfy a strict total order.
spec_anchor: 42 §2.1-2 "duplicate keys of the same name are not permitted" / req/33 §4 A-9
